visual_logic.color_palette: Olive-green with muddy-brown mottling and high-contrast white spots on the flippers, running continuously along its horizontal profile.
visual_logic.action: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. The hovering behavior is stabilized parallel to the frame boundaries.
visual_logic.environment: Deep blue water with olive-green sediment clouds. The cluster of large clay ammonites and distant clay-textured fauna are shifted entirely into the background layers to preserve a sharp, measurable silhouette line.

pose: The microcleidid plesiosaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original vertical suspension and upward-looking pose are unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, stretching its small head, long neck, compact body, large flippers (flattened toward the camera plane), and tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
